name: Character Transformation Engine — Evidence & Claim Graph API
endpoints: Traverse backward to observations and sources.
Return support, replication, qualification and contradiction edges.
Assess claim level under registered rules.
Register or update a contradiction set.

claim_rules.hypothesis_to_result: Requires an analysis/result node linked to registered measurement/data.
claim_rules.result_to_replicated: Requires an independent replication edge satisfying registered replication criteria.
claim_rules.replicated_to_generalized: Requires explicit target population/context and generalization analysis.
claim_rules.evidence_supported: Requires registered evidence criteria; no automatic promotion from statistical significance.
claim_rules.contradiction: Contradictory results remain linked and visible.

inference_blocks.reason: Association alone does not establish causality.
Replication requires an independent replication run.
Significance alone does not establish practical importance.
Model output requires provenance-supported evidence criteria.
